units: <cite ref="Beitzah 25b:8">Bets. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>אף עז וכ׳</he> (among the aggressive creatures, v. <cite ref="P00385"><he>עַז</he></cite>) also the goat among the small cattle.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 3:1">Bekh. III, 1</cite> <he>עז בת שנתה וכ׳</he> that born of a goat in her first year belongs surely to the priest (as first-born); a. fr.—Pl. <he>עִזִּים</he>.
